sources.summary: Future AI-integrated Radio Access Networks (AI-RAN) will combine open programmability with learning-enabled xApps, rApps, and control functions that act on shared parameters and key performance indicators (KPIs). sources.title: ZeetLex/knitting-library
sources.summary: Knitting Library is a self-hosted personal knitting pattern manager. Upload PDF patterns or scanned image sheets, browse them in a searchable grid, annotate pages, track active projects with a row counter, and manage a full yarn inventory. Built with FastAPI and React, served from one port, with no external dependencies at runtime.
